board.limits: Board annotation frames are not website UI; repeated specimens are not independent sites.

boardRegions.title: Navigation
observations: Closed/open navigation states range from compact dropdowns to full-width grouped menus.
Header treatment follows media contrast and distinct visitor tasks.

boardRegions.title: First hero
observations: Full-bleed media, booking splits, poster rails and editorial splits coexist.
Select identification, evidence and primary action using the actual subject/assets.

boardRegions.title: Fast decisions
observations: 9 specimens: calendars/agendas, two posters, service selector/details, client cases, editorial resources and priced booking.
Quick means a short decision path, not a compulsory tiny row.

boardRegions.title: Short showcase
observations: 6 specimens: portrait promotions, news masonry, news covers, demonstrations, projects and resources.
Preserve recognition and comparable metadata.

boardRegions.title: Wide showcase
observations: 9 specimens including a standalone invitation, landscape editorials, products, evidence splits and portrait programs.
Wide describes composition territory, not a fixed card aspect ratio.

boardRegions.title: Shallow information
observations: 9 specimens: repeated service/catalog/benefit examples plus resources, partner proof, contact, stories and video/poster compositions.
Several examples repeat from the wide row; do not count as independent sites.

boardRegions.title: Composite panels
observations: 3 specimens: news/newsletter pair, six-photo mosaic and social/video/subscription collection.
Give each region a clear priority and destination.

boardRegions.title: Operational close
observations: 7 specimens: contact/legal/support, branded invitation, imagery, inquiry form and utility columns.
Match complexity to real organization tasks; preserve practical information.

cases.name: Busan International Film Festival
observations: Two-tier institutional header and image-led hero share space with timed event cards.
Four comparable film stills carry premiere labels, names and country/year/duration; news rows use structural rules.
avoid: Static snapshot content differs from current live text; do not copy event dates or sponsor assets.

cases.name: NOL Theater Daehakro

source.liveAccess: 403; redirected to error page; live behavior unverified

observations: Performance artwork dominates the hero; poster listings retain venue, period and title below.
A 3-by-2 visit-guide grid uses named icons for seating, floor guide, services, FAQ and directions.
avoid: Icon grids can serve navigation; truncated titles and dark surfaces still need independent readability checks.

cases.name: GS Arts Center

source.liveAccess: response accessible; redirected /en; no extracted text

observations: A spare identity/navigation field faces unequal image columns; performance metadata has its own text territory.
Read/watch items have varied image heights with category/title/date, followed by contact, utilities and newsletter footer.
avoid: Editorial asymmetry is optional; a booking-heavy page may need a more immediate action.

cases.name: Leeum Museum
observations: White grouped navigation and generous text space precede a broad artwork photograph.
Paired exhibition media aligns names/dates; collection images form shallow landscape bands.
avoid: Visible placeholder exhibit titles in the supplied capture must not become real content in a generated page.

cases.name: Jeonju International Film Festival
observations: Festival graphic forms lead the hero; repeated event cards use real stills and consistent fields.
Date/time and venue are divided by thin structural rules; live text includes an agenda/calendar.
avoid: Graphic masks express this festival identity; they are not a default way to crop another brand.

cases.name: Onmaru Arts Space
observations: Atmospheric shadow-image hero and centered Korean serif title lead to eight topic pills.
An asymmetric three-line Korean introduction, artwork band, video/notices and operational footer vary the reading density.
avoid: Atmosphere suits an arts subject; preserve identification and evidence for other contexts.

cases.name: Centre Pompidou Hanwha
observations: Two-tier header includes six principal links plus opening/account/ticket utilities above architecture media.
Exhibition text/poster is roughly 1:3; mark-derived bars and paired membership/help sections continue the system.
avoid: Museum utility complexity should not be copied into a single-purpose microsite.

cases.name: Cruziana Golf and Resort

source.liveAccess: response accessible; no extracted text; live layout unverified

observations: Full-width landscape hero uses a large lower serif place name and ruled resource links.
Warm information fields, broad course media and address/map/contact form a place-led sequence.
avoid: A monumental name cannot replace booking details or first-time orientation.

cases.name: SEAMARQ Hotel
observations: Image-first opening is supported by persistent booking utility; later architecture media includes headline, paging and booking bar.
Offers pair category controls with substantial imagery; practical contact/legal information closes the page.
avoid: An image-only opening depends on recognition and booking access; it is not a general no-headline rule.

cases.name: MUSINSA Corporate
observations: News-led opening allocates roughly 2:1 dominant media versus secondary story/utility column.
A centered three-line Korean manifesto and news rail with three complete items plus a preview continue below.
avoid: The stacked column serves editorial priorities; do not turn it into an automatic feature bento.

cases.name: Seojin System
observations: Manufacturing-image hero combines a Korean proposition and three compact previews.
Text/image split and six-category thumbnail selector precede a dark network region, recruitment and detailed footer.
avoid: Division selectors require real divisions; never invent categories to reproduce geometry.

cases.name: MG Insurance
observations: A dominant product panel and smaller login panel precede ten named service shortcuts.
Outlined product cards, category icons, recommendations and notices form distinct task territories inside a restrained container.
avoid: Mascots and service-card density fit this portal; they are not mandatory visual language for another brand.

builds.name: ONSIL / 온실

browserQA.inputMethodNote: Automated pointer/Escape plus programmatic date/select changes; additional keyboard review is documented separately.

limits: Recorded local results, not a fresh verification run.
Saved reports retain final PASS results; initial failed captures were not kept.
Filter QA derives expected cards from the DOM; documented 3/2/1 inventory is not independently asserted by that check.
No production accessibility certification, real venue data, booking provider or payment processing.

observations: Original generated media and real Korean typography form an editorial botanical exhibition page; matching catalog fields support comparison.
Implementation review documented a journal image-height repair and medium-width running copy raised to 16px; initial failed captures/reports were not retained.
Filters, date/time/count states, closure/sold-out validation, stale-slot reset, honest demo confirmation and focus restoration were exercised.
Affected visual rechecks covered scrolled modal close/title visibility and an open mobile menu crossing into desktop.
avoid: Do not treat ONSIL forest colors, serif type, lime actions, image count or three-program inventory as universal defaults.
Do not copy its current prices, dates or fictional venue as business facts.
Do not infer all keyboard/screen-reader behavior from programmatic control changes or treat 0 FAIL as a design grade.
